target_database: ValueWeave Supabase (Postgres) — Layer I: District Intelligent Digital Infrastructure
approval_status: NOT APPROVED FOR PUBLICATION — per governance workflow (Part 4 of the Data Collection & Governance Framework), this batch requires Data Steward triage and Reviewer sign-off before an Approver may publish it. Recommended status on import: verification_status = VST-NEEDS_REVIEW (already set in the CSVs), NOT VST-VERIFIED.

pre_import_checks: Confirm st_ref values (TG, AP) do not already exist in target table
Confirm lookup FK columns (none for this table) — N/A

depends_on: state.csv must be imported first — st_id is a foreign key
pre_import_checks: Confirm every st_id value resolves to a row already present in the state table (referential integrity)
Confirm all 61 dist_ref values are unique (validated pre-export: PASS)
Confirm no PENDING_VERIFICATION or PENDING_GEOCODING sentinel values are misread as literal data by the target system — these must map to NULL or a flagged staging state, not be imported as text

post_import_actions_required: Route both tables through the Correction/Verification workflow (Governance Framework Part 4.2) before promoting verification_status from VST-NEEDS_REVIEW to VST-VERIFIED
Schedule a dedicated LGD bulk-download task to populate lgd_state_code and lgd_district_code (currently 100% PENDING_VERIFICATION)
Schedule a batch geocoding task (e.g., via OpenStreetMap Nominatim or Bhuvan) to populate latitude/longitude (currently 100% PENDING_GEOCODING)
Directly fetch the AP government gazette/district notification to (a) confirm the Anakapalli/Ananthapuramu code resolution and (b) obtain area/population for Polavaram and Markapuram districts
Do NOT populate district_readiness_score at this stage — that field belongs to the AI Intelligence Layer's own derived-data pipeline (Profile P5), not this collection batch
rollback_plan: This is an initial batch (no prior version exists for state/district tables), so rollback = drop/truncate the two tables and re-import from the prior CSV version if a critical error is found post-import; no in-place data existed to preserve.
error_reporting: Any row failing FK/uniqueness validation at import time should be written to a companion `district_import_errors.csv` (row content + failed rule) rather than silently skipped, per the Data Quality Framework's validation rules.
